covered.title: California Alternative Workweek 4x10 Settings — Live in Production
covered.summary: CA locations can opt in per employee to a 4-days/10-hour alternative workweek setting so daily overtime starts after 10 hours for approved schedules.

covered.title: New Left Navigation — Moving to 100% of Customers June 17
covered.summary: The redesigned left navigation moves to all customers on June 17 and should be treated as the default web experience.

covered.title: Blitz Mode Relaunched Monday with GTM OS Fixes Live
covered.summary: Blitz Mode relaunched June 15 after GTM OS fixes for account loading, ranking, cadence spacing, talk tracks, notes, locations, payroll status, and skip reasons.

covered.title: Inbound Inception Pipeline Is Now in GTM OS
covered.summary: Inbound Inception's existing pipeline moved into GTM OS on June 15 with stage-aware cadence placement and manual rep calls first.
